scenes.say: The Formula Two leader won't start in Qatar. So who decides the title?
Câmara has two oh seven, Tsolov two hundred, Dunne one eighty-nine. Câmara can't add more.
Câmara races for Haas in Formula One, and Freddie Slater makes his debut in the Invicta car.
A driver can take thirty-nine points in a weekend, seventy-eight across the two rounds.
Tsolov needs eight points to lead. Second in the sprint pays exactly that.
Dunne is eleven behind Tsolov. Nineteen would pass Câmara: second in the feature plus fastest lap.
Tsolov can only seal it in Qatar by getting more than thirty-nine points clear of every close rival.
Sprint Saturday, feature race Sunday. Abu Dhabi closes it on the fifth and sixth of December.

title: The F2 title: Tsolov, Dunne and two rounds without the points leader
